content:
maya: deploy-bot flagged promote for payments-worker -> staging blocked during preflight. error shows artifact signature verification failed and storage returned 403 on signature fetch. release window in 22m. thoughts?

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion blocked: signature verification failed for payments-worker:2026-03-24-rc7. Details:
``nERROR verify: signature fetch failed: GET https://signing.internal.company/artifacts/payments-worker/2026-03-24-rc7.sig -> 403 Forbidden
verify: expected-signer=ci-signer-v3, observed=NONE, manifest-checksum=4a7b9d...
```
owen: 403 to signer usually means KMS role change or signer rotated keys. Quick options: 1) pin to last-good artifact payments-worker:2026-03-10-rc3, 2) bypass signature verification for this window (not ideal), 3) re-sign artifacts with the new signer and re-run preflight. Pin is fastest.
sophie: bypassing verification is a big security no. re-sign + re-run might take ~12-15m and still race the window. pin + note is safest.
maya: any runtime compatibility risk with rc3?
liam (svc-owner): rc3 removed a debug endpoint but no API/DB changes. safe for staging canary. I'm +1 to pin.

releases-bot: policy check: pin allowed for minor patch-only differences and if svc-owner approves. Liam approved.

owen: i'll attempt a parallel re-sign job in case we want to flip post-release: `ci-signer re-sign --artifact payments-worker:2026-03-24-rc7 --target-bucket gs://artifacts-staging/resigned/`

maya: do pin then. ben (i'll act as release-manager) — actually ben OOO today, i'm covering. Executing promote --pin payments-worker:2026-03-10-rc3 and hold canary. I'll update release notes.

deploy-bot: action: `promote --pin payments-worker:2026-03-10-rc3` executed by maya at 3111112700. Canary state: held (1/3). Re-sign job kicked off by owen.

maya: release notes bullet: 'pinned payments-worker to 2026-03-10-rc3 due to failed signature fetch/verification for rc7 (403 from internal signer); re-sign attempt in progress; will triage and decide whether to flip after release.'

owen: re-sign job completed and re-uploaded signatures to gs://artifacts-staging/resigned/; verify now passes locally: new-signature-checksum=4a7b9d... verified. Since we pinned, we will not flip during the window without full triage.

maya: created follow-up ticket https://tracker.company/RED-8123 to investigate signer role rotation and re-sign workflow. closing thread for release window: pinned + canary held. :white_check_mark:
